items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:37:1
items.html: When the upper light descends within ZA, it does not pass through a screen at all, etc.; and just as those lights came out from the Mochin of Aba, etc.: For ZA received those Mochin in the discernment of Gadlut, at which time the Daat is found — from the coupling of HB in his Rosh [head], from below upward — and afterwards spreads in the illumination of Hochma from above downward, through the Yesod of Ima clothed within him down to the Chazeh [chest]; and from the Chazeh downward, it is revealed in that same illumination as ZA of Aba himself. And this is what is said: ‘and just as those lights came out from the Mochin of Aba’ to ZA of Aba, ‘so are they now within Zeir in that very same illumination’ — meaning only the illumination of Hochma, but not actual Hochma, for this is the entire difference between Aba and ZA: Aba is the light of Hochma in his very self, whereas ZA — his self is the light of Hassadim, but with an illumination of Hochma within his Hassadim. As is written in the Zohar (Mishpatim, item 520): that the Rosh of the King is established in Hesed and Gevura.
